quote: We further demonstrate the generalizability of our model by adapting it to diverse downstream tasks: video-and-language inference and video captioning tasks...
With a simple addition of a Transformer decoder, we can extend HERO for multimodal video captioning. ... We evaluate HERO on TVC and report BLEU@4, METEOR, ROUGE-L, and CIDEr-D scores.
